lines.text: At the start of Jehoiakim's reign, the LORD told Jeremiah to speak in the courtyard so the people might turn.
The LORD said that if the people did not listen, He would make His house like Bethel.
When Jeremiah finished speaking, the priests, prophets and people seized him, and the officials sat at the New Gate.
The elders said Micah the Moreshite prophesied in Hezekiah's days, and Hezekiah did not put him to death.
King Jehoiakim had Uriah brought back from Babylon and killed, but Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah.
